newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan oil sector leads gainers after dollar fall.
newsitem.headline: Japan oil sector leads gainers after dollar fall.

text.p: Japan's oil sector 0#OIL.T led gainers on the Tokyo stock market on Friday as investors sold export-strong issues and bought import-reliant ones after the yen strengthened against the dollar, brokers said.
As of 0505 GMT, the sector index .NOIL was up 1.12 percent, or 10.46 points, at 945.53.
Nippon Oil Co Ltd was up 12 yen at 637. It was the second most actively traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with 7.04 million shares changing hands.
Showa Shell Sekiyu KK added 19 yen to 970 and Tonen Corp rose 10 yen to 1,300. Koa Oil Co Ltd rose 34 yen to 750.

"The high-tech sector is easing rapidly due to the strengthening of the yen against the dollar, but on the other hand, market participants, led by dealers, are buying issues that benefit from a stronger yen," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said.
